name: TBO Frappe Dev
description: Builds Frappe and ERPNext features from a TBO Support task the way TBO does: a branch named after the task, TBO's Frappe conventions, module tests on your bench, the linters your CI runs, and a pull request that moves the task to Pending Review. Uses your own git, GitHub CLI login and bench; never pushes to shared branches or force-pushes.
author: Team Back Office

agentTools.name: tbo_dev
agentTools.description:
Build a Frappe/ERPNext change from a TBO Support task, in the repository open in the workspace (or `repo`, a folder inside it). Choose an action:
- status: the repository, its branch and task, what is installed (git, gh and its login, uv, the bench and test site).
- start_work: create or switch to the task's branch (feature/TASK-…-short-name, or fix/… with kind fix) from the remote's default branch or `base` (the remote: origin, else upstream as bench get-app names it). Needs task and subject (tbo_support get_task's branch_subject). Refuses a dirty working tree.
- check: run the linters the repository's CI runs (pre-commit on changed files, Semgrep with Frappe's rules, commit titles) on the committed branch. Runs in the background: answers with a job.
- run_tests: run the test modules the branch touched (or `modules`) on the local bench's test site, one by one; never the whole suite. Runs in the background.
- job_status: the outcome of a check or run_tests job (`job`, or the latest of `kind`).
Commit with conventional titles (feat: …, fix(scope): …). Then open the PR with tbo_dev_pr.

repo.description: The repository folder, relative to the workspace, when the workspace is not the repository itself (e.g. apps/my_app).

task.description: start_work: the TBO Support task, e.g. TASK-2026-00021.

subject.description: start_work: the task's subject; it becomes the branch's short name.

kind.description: start_work: fix for a bug fix, else feature.

base.description: start_work: the branch to start from, when the repository's AGENTS.md names one; default the remote's default branch.

modules.description: run_tests: test modules such as my_app.tests.test_invoices; default the ones the branch touched.

job.description: job_status: the job id check or run_tests answered.

job_kind.description: job_status: the latest job of this kind, when no job id is given.

skip_hooks.description: check: pre-commit hooks to leave out, only when the check said their tools cannot be installed and the change has no file they check. Recorded in the PR.

agentTools.name: tbo_dev_pr
agentTools.description: Open the pull request for the task's branch: pushes the branch with the developer's own GitHub login, opens the PR with the repository's template (TBO's when it has none), the title TASK-…: summary and 'Closes TASK-…', then marks it ready for review so TBO Support moves the task to Pending Review. Needs a passing tbo_dev check on the current commit and a clean working tree, and the tbo_dev run_tests result for the commit or no_tests_reason. Never pushes to main, master, develop, tbo or the default branch, and never force-pushes.

repo.description: The repository folder, relative to the workspace, when the workspace is not the repository itself.

summary.description: One line: what the PR does (it follows 'TASK-…: ' in the title).

what_and_why.description: What changes and the problem it solves (markdown).

link.description: Closes (merging completes the task; default) or Refs (the PR is part of the task).

no_tests_reason.description: Why no tests were run on this commit, when none were.

reviewers.description: GitHub logins to ask for a review; default the plugin setting.

draft.description: true: leave it a draft (the task stays Working until it is marked ready).

settings.title: Frappe bench folder
settings.description: The bench whose test site runs the tests, e.g. /Users/you/frappe-bench. Empty: the bench that holds the repository as apps/<app>.

settings.title: Test site
settings.description: A local site with the app installed and allow_tests on, e.g. dev.localhost. Empty: the bench's current site. Never a live site.

settings.title: Reviewers
settings.description: GitHub logins asked to review every pull request you open, separated by commas. Empty: nobody is asked (the PR is still marked ready for review).

settings.title: bench command
settings.description: The bench CLI, if it is not on your PATH as bench.

settings.title: uv location
settings.description: Where uv is, if the app does not find it (the linters run through uv).
